verdict.rationale: Docs confirm GoogleSQL is an ANSI-compliant SQL surface with DML, procedural extensions, pipe syntax, and table-valued functions, and community feedback praises its productivity for data exploration (bigquery-docs-23, bigquery-docs-30, bigquery-docs-70, bigquery-docs-87, bigquery-comm-15, bigquery-comm-16), implying a rich native SQL surface without bolt-ons. However, the pack never explicitly documents window functions, CTEs, JSON/semi-structured handling, ARRAY/STRUCT types, or the rich DATE/TIME/TIMESTAMP type system that the story specifically calls out. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of window functions, CTE support, native JSON/semi-structured querying, array/struct handling, and date/time type richness.
